sourceDefects: 27 edge-adjacent components, nonwatertight. Used as design reference only; original CSG reconstruction, no automatic repair.

measuredSource.sourceCodeCorroboration: flat_clip.scad: hole thickness=1.6+0.1; clip width adds .25 each side. Inspected downloaded upstream source.

designMapping.sheet: 2.2–3.0 mm instead of 1.6 for stronger stand, pattern backing and art backing.
designMapping.sockets: 4.50 mm measured SOCKET baseline becomes new straight tongue width. Source male clip was 4.00 mm. New sockets (4.50+c) × (sheet+c), c total .10–.30. Two glue joints; no source snap-latch copied.
designMapping.carrier: Original four-shelf rectangular CSG carrier, 16 real 0.4–0.6 mm bed-flat runners (stronger than source .21–.22).
designMapping.pattern: Original radius 23–32 mm wheel with .4 mm recessed half-annulus, 3–5 independent arc tracks, 20–60 degree sweeps and 0–70 degree phase spread. White hub and 1.5 mm rim retained. Black pigment applied manually, STL does not store colour.
designMapping.interaction: New hand-spun Benham-type subjective colour kit, not a repeated source spacecraft, geometric proof board or prior stroboscope. No simulated colours or motorization.
designMapping.shaft: Three coaxial M3+diametral clearance bores; external bolt, locknut and thin washers. Printed spacer thickness=sheet. 0.20 mm nominal allowance each side for thin washers; no hardware strength claim.
designMapping.guard: Wheel axis radius+8 above base top. Rotor and spacer clear tower axially. 24 poses cover full turn computationally.
designMapping.art: True Boolean base engraving at Y=-8 mm, radius≤6.5 mm, .4–.6 mm depth, leaves ≥1.5 mm backing. Supported STL cutter geometry is preserved, not hulled.

reusedInfrastructure: Generic local studio UI, parsers, worker, serializer, carrier packing and browser regression harness adapted from Daily Object Lab. All wheel/pattern, tower, shaft stack and independent fit/motion tests are new.

theory.name: Benham top / subjective pattern-induced colours
theory.scope: Factual interaction inspiration only. Custom half-annulus pattern, not exact historic top; optical effect not tested or guaranteed.
